info.title: L3_Composite_Group
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

active_resolved_members.description: Indicates the list of resolved members which should be used: `mpls`:                  Use resolved_mpls_members list. `unresolved`:            There are no active members.

data_path_state.description: Indicates the state the data path is in: `ecmp`:                    Forward traffic to more than one                             nexthop.                            Balance flows to multiple nexthops.                            If nexthops are on different ports,                            the effect of increasing available                            bandwidth. `l3_dest_ecmp_group`:      Composite Group uses both L3 Dest                            and ECMP Group `l3_dest_tunnel_endpoint`: Composite Group uses both L3 Dest                            and Tunnel Endpoint `single`:                  Forward traffic to the single,                             resolved nexthop. `unresolved`:              Waiting for dependencies to become                            resolved.

hw_config.description: Indicates the hardware IDs which should be used in cases where dp_state is 'ecmp' or 'single'

ecmp_id.description: ECMP Group ID assigned by L3RM

l3_destination_id.description: L3 destination index assigned by L3RM

id.description:
Reference Resource: [L3_Composite_Group](#/L3_Composite_Group)
Abstracted value which is generated to identify each of the Composite Groups.

nexthops.description:
Reference Resource: [Nexthop](#/Nexthop)
The list of Nexthops which will be used in a composite group.

resolved_mpls_members.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Endpoint](#/Label_Endpoint)
The list of Label_Endpoints which will be used in a composite group with 'mpls' active_resolved_members.

tunnel_endpoint.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
Tunnel Endpoints corresponding to this Composite Group.

type.description: Indicates how the l3_composite_group is used: `mpls`:                Used to configure MPLS routes. `protected_dest`:      Used to configure protected nexthop groups. `vxlan`:               Used to configure hosts learned over VxLAN tunnel. `ecmp_dlb`:        Used to configure Dynamic load balanced ECMP Group.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
